## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.

## Scientific & Laboratory Equipment Manufacturers in India

**ACMAS Technologies Pvt. Ltd.** is a leading [**scientific equipment manufacturer**][21] and
[**laboratory equipment manufacturer in India**][22], providing reliable instruments for research,
testing, and industrial applications. As trusted **manufacturers**, **suppliers**, and **exporters**
of scientific and laboratory equipment, we serve industries such as *automotive*, *pharmaceutical*,
*aerospace*, *defense*, *telecommunications* etc.

With advanced manufacturing capabilities and years of industry experience, we deliver high-quality
equipment designed for accuracy, durability, and consistent laboratory performance. In addition to
standard models, we also develop **[customized laboratory and scientific equipment][23]** to meet
specific testing and research requirements.

## Test Chambers for Scientific Laboratory

Apart from being a reliable laboratory equipment manufacturer, ACMAS Technologies is also among the
recognized [**test chamber manufacturers, suppliers, and exporters in India**][24]. Our
environmental test chambers are widely used in scientific laboratories and quality control
departments to evaluate product reliability under controlled conditions.

We design and manufacture [**customized test chambers**][25] that simulate temperature, humidity,
and environmental stress for accurate testing and validation. Few of our Test Chambers include:

Thermal Shock Chamber

zones (2 zone and 3 zone), liquid to liquid (2 zone).

temperature, humidity, and/or vibration environments.

[Know More][27]
Ozone Test Chamber

[Ozone Test Chamber]

against ozone degradation in a controlled environment.

[Know More][28]
Sand & Dust Chambers

[Sand & Dust Test Chamber]

Our Sand and Dust Test Chamber provide an environment to test the exposure of automotive and
electronic components to concentrated levels of dust.

[Know More][29]
Rain Test Chamber

[Rain Test Chamber]

Our Rain Test Chambers are such rain test machines used for the testing of automobiles, electronic
parts and components, light equipments, voltage cabinets etc.

[Know More][30]
Walk-in Test Chamber

covers various applications from JEDEC and IEC test standards.

# Empowering Drug Development

Avance Biosciences is a leading Contract Research Organization (CRO) and Contract Testing
Organization (CTO) providing CGMP and GLP-compliant analytical and bioanalytical services to support
drug development.

[CONTACT US][155]
[EXPLORE SERVICES][156]

Empowering Drug Development


Avance Biosciences is a leading CRO and CTO providing CGMP and GLP-compliant assay development,
assay validation, and sample testing services to support drug development and manufacturing
activities for our clients world-wide.

Comprehensive Testing Solutions
Across Therapeutic Modalities

We provide comprehensive analytical solutions for various drug and biologics modalities, including
gene therapies, cell therapies, vaccines, mAbs, ADCs, proteins, and small molecule drugs. These
integrated services confirm product sterility, evaluate cellular responses, and quantify therapeutic
antibodies and biomarkers, ensuring the safety, efficacy, and quality of pharmaceuticals for
regulatory approval and patient well-being.

a multiplicative inverse  is basically a reciprocal

**Multiplicative inverse = 16/79**

The multiplicative inverse of 1/16 ÷ 1/81 +-1/8?

### Get help

to tackle your toughest questions.

amitnrw

**Given :  **1/16 ÷ 1/81 + - 1/8

**To find:**  multiplicative inverse

**Solution:**

a multiplicative inverse  is basically a reciprocal

Multiplicative inverse of number  is the number which if multiplied by original number result in 1

1/16 ÷ 1/81 + -1/8

1/16 ÷ 1/81 = 81/16

+ - 1/8 = - 1/8

81/16 - 1/8

= 81/16 - 2/16

= (81 - 2)/16

= 79/16

**Multiplicative inverse = 16/79**

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## Why choose an External Quality Assessment (EQA) or proficiency test (PT) in molecular
## diagnostics?

### Assure quality | Prevent errors | Interpret correctly

As a molecular diagnostics service provider, you want to be sure that you offer the best possible
service. This is where EQAs can provide a wide range of benefits, whether you’re a hospital
laboratory or a private testing company:
* Regulatory compliance and accreditation
* Quality assurance & risk mitigation
* Objective evidence
* Standardisation & harmonisation
* Continuous professional evaluation & development
* Relied on by patients and treating physicians

EMQN is leading global provider of quality assurance tools and knowledge to the human molecular
pathology and genomics testing community. Our network of highly experienced assessors will guide you
to diagnostic excellence. 

## Look no further:
## We offer more than just assessment

### The best schemes and assessments

EMQN **offers External Quality Assessment (EQA) schemes**, also referred to as proficiency tests
(PT). But we go far beyond simply selling these schemes.

**EMQN’s EQA schemes are designed and developed to test the whole analytical process of a molecular
diagnostics laboratory, from sample, through testing and interpretation, to final report.**

For each EQA we provide at least two **expert peer assessors** who will meticulously evaluate your
ability to interpret your results in relation to mock clinical referral information, as well as
assessing the clarity and accuracy of your final report.

Participation means you can rest assured you are providing the best possible clinical diagnostic
procedures, analytical performance, and clinical interpretation.

* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After
  entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a
  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.

  Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your
  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.
* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or
  upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and
  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.

  makes content more engaging and memorable.
* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
  [Prezi for Teams][24] is an ideal solution.

* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After

  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to

  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.

  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

## Why Busy Families Love Our Dinner Recipes

Need dinner recipes that work for real life? We test every recipe in our own busy kitchens so you
get meals that are:

✅ 30 minutes max for weeknight dinners

✅ Picky-eater approved family favorites

✅ Make-ahead & freezer friendly for busy weeks

✅ Simple ingredients from any grocery store

### How The Student Room is moderated

To keep The Student Room safe for everyone, we moderate posts that are added to the site.

[Our moderation system picks up rule-breaking content][122] and also means we can help people when
needed. We have a team of human moderators, who are assisted by automated systems and AI technology.
Community members can report problem posts too: you'll find each post has a report button at the
bottom. Our moderators aim to act upon all reports within 24 hours.

On top of all that, we have [more than 60 Volunteer Team members][123]. These superstars look after
discussions on The Student Room, helping to make it a fun, safe and useful place to hang out.

## How to get started

In just a few simple steps you can set up your account and start asking our welcoming and friendly
community your questions.

Join discussions with current students, university staff and other experts sharing their specialist
knowledge.

The Student Room is a safe space where you can find trusted advice and genuine support.

## Help with your university application

You don't have to do your Ucas application alone. Our guides and forums will help you get it sorted.

[Ucas application advice forum][124][Personal statement advice forum][125][Personal statement
examples][126]
[Uni chat forums][127][Student finance info][128]

##### Did you know...

We've got a brand new app that helps you take The Student Room wherever you go. It's quick and easy
to use. Download the app, sign in and join the discussion.
Go to my App Store

## Join The Student Room

Our current students chat about everything from GCSEs to apprenticeships, A-levels to UCAS
applications. The Student Room is a warm, welcoming community that can offer you expert advice and
support.

Simply sign up for free and tell us a little about yourself to gain access to:
* Personalised content just for you
* Ask our friendly community anything
* Get advice from fellow students and experts
* Join discussions and help others
* Stay in the loop with notifications when you watch discussions

# Discuss and discover, together.

We're The Student Room: the UK's largest online community for school, college and uni students. Find
friendly and supportive discussions on everything from GCSEs to uni life, from A-levels to Ucas
applications.
Latest
For you

## What Students Say

### The website is brilliant for students in need of advice regarding exams and revision.

Year 11

### It's really useful to see what other people are saying about GCSEs (and non-school stuff!).

Year 11

### Sometimes I find my self stuck at a crossroads and The Student Room can provide answers that may
### point me in the right direction.

Year 12

### Great advice and tips to help me through A-Levels and answers a lot of my questions about Uni.

Year 13

### Super easy to use and contains an abundance of info on all topics concerning young people in
### education today.

Year 13

### The Student Room has provided me with very useful information regarding my university choices,
### as well as life as a university student. It helped me decide to go for Psychology.

Year 13

### How The Student Room is moderated

To keep The Student Room safe for everyone, we moderate posts that are added to the site.

[Our moderation system picks up rule-breaking content][122] and also means we can help people when
needed. We have a team of human moderators, who are assisted by automated systems and AI technology.
Community members can report problem posts too: you'll find each post has a report button at the
bottom. Our moderators aim to act upon all reports within 24 hours.

On top of all that, we have [more than 60 Volunteer Team members][123]. These superstars look after
discussions on The Student Room, helping to make it a fun, safe and useful place to hang out.

## How to get started

In just a few simple steps you can set up your account and start asking our welcoming and friendly
community your questions.

Join discussions with current students, university staff and other experts sharing their specialist
knowledge.

The Student Room is a safe space where you can find trusted advice and genuine support.

## Help with your university application

You don't have to do your Ucas application alone. Our guides and forums will help you get it sorted.

[Ucas application advice forum][124][Personal statement advice forum][125][Personal statement
examples][126]
[Uni chat forums][127][Student finance info][128]

##### Did you know...

We've got a brand new app that helps you take The Student Room wherever you go. It's quick and easy
to use. Download the app, sign in and join the discussion.
Go to my App Store

## Join The Student Room

Our current students chat about everything from GCSEs to apprenticeships, A-levels to UCAS
applications. The Student Room is a warm, welcoming community that can offer you expert advice and
support.

Simply sign up for free and tell us a little about yourself to gain access to:
* Personalised content just for you
* Ask our friendly community anything
* Get advice from fellow students and experts
* Join discussions and help others
* Stay in the loop with notifications when you watch discussions
Sign up
